definitions.gloss: truck bed, loading platform, cargo area
definitions.explanation: The flat open area at the back of a truck or vehicle used for carrying goods. Also refers to the rear rack of a bicycle.

examples.japanese: トラックの{荷台|にだい}に{荷物|にもつ}を{載|の}せる。
examples.english: I load goods onto the truck bed.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{荷台|にだい}にかばんをくくりつけた。
examples.english: I strapped a bag to the bicycle rack.

examples.japanese: {荷台|にだい}に{人|ひと}を{乗|の}せて{走|はし}るのは{道路|どうろ}{交通|こうつう}{法|ほう}{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Driving with people riding on the truck bed is a traffic violation.

notes:
USAGE:
{荷台|にだい} can refer to the cargo area of a truck ({軽|けい}トラック, pickup truck), or to the rear rack on a bicycle. The word combines {荷|に} (load, cargo) with {台|だい} (platform).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷台|にだい}に{載|の}せる: to load onto the cargo area
- {荷台|にだい}から{降|お}ろす: to unload from the cargo area
- トラックの{荷台|にだい}: truck bed
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{荷台|にだい}: bicycle rack
